title: Core: add an OpenTelemetry MetricsReporter
summary: moomindani proposed an OpenTelemetry-based MetricsReporter in iceberg-core that exports ScanReport and CommitReport through an SDK registered by the host application, with only opentelemetry-api added as a compileOnly dependency (issue #16169, PR #16250). He asked whether the dependency is acceptable and whether the code belongs in iceberg-core or a separate module. Replies supported the idea. rdblue accepted the compileOnly dependency but asked that packaging meet user expectations. vaquar khan pointed out that the snapshot ID attribute has unbounded cardinality; it was removed. grantatspothero suggested a span-based reporter because per-table attributes can also be high cardinality; the author made the attribute set configurable and deferred spans. Documentation on packaging the exporter was added at Jean-Baptiste Onofré's request. The author said he would proceed with iceberg-core and compileOnly, having heard no objection.

positions.stance: Add a metrics-only OpenTelemetry reporter in iceberg-core with opentelemetry-api as compileOnly; span support should be a separate design.
OpenTelemetry is a good vendor-neutral integration layer, and a REST catalog is usually not the right place to act as a metrics platform.
Adding opentelemetry-api as compileOnly is fine, provided the packaging matches what users expect and avoids surprise failures.
The snapshot ID attribute creates unbounded metric cardinality and should be removed, made opt-in or documented; a combined-reporter test should be added.
A span-based implementation should be considered because table-name attributes can be high cardinality with thousands of tables.
Starting with metrics is reasonable and spans can come later; how to package the exporter should be documented.

outcome.note: No objection was raised to the compileOnly opentelemetry-api dependency or to placing the reporter in iceberg-core, and the author said he would proceed on that basis in PR #16250. Span-based reporting was deferred.

why_it_matters: It sets the pattern for an optional observability integration in iceberg-core: API-only compileOnly dependency, SDK and exporter supplied by the host, and bounded metric attributes.
